changelog:
first:
# THIS VERSION DROP VERSION UNDER 1.21.0, use 1.x.x if you want continuation of support use v1
Hi ! This is the first release of the 2.x.x series
It contain most of the same fixes and features. but new features will mostly be created
The major version bump is here to indicate the dropping of these older versions as this project use [semver](https://semver.org/) and not "big new feature"

This support drop should not impact a lot of servers as version under 1.21.0 represent less than 1% of the plugin server base
plus, 1.x.x still has some bugfix support

Anyway ! here's actual changelog ! (a bit of a repeat with 1.19.0)
### Features:
- added anvil degradation
- added anvil sound
I know these two previous features did took time to arive. I had a blocking road block that I fixed rfecently so I was able to implement it easily

### Fixes:
- upgraded eco enchant, if you see an issue like class not found please upgrade your version of eco enchant
- proper handling of eco item (and do not assume present if eco enchant is present, actually check if it is)
- warn on datapack issue instead of crashing
- fix non vanilla handling of rename on unformated rename
- fix some custom recipe not working
- made duplicate registered name warnining only log on debug log

### Removal
- Support for 1.20.6 and before
- Legacy commands (`/anvilconfigreload` `/customanvilconfig`). use `/ca subcommands `instead (like `/ca config` and `/ca )

changelog:
This update has a lot of QOL & removal of legacy features 
## Features
- add `/ca config item` and `/ca config enchant` for per item type and per enchant(s) config gui
This is a very useful feature to configure one enchantment instead of having to find it
- add `/ca enchant` to easily enchant 
require the `ca.command.enchantment` permission. Default allowed for OP
- add support for [EnchantedBook](https://modrinth.com/plugin/enchantedbook)

## Fixes & Other
- move `/ca gui` to `/ca config`
- Prefer `/ca` over deprecated commands
- fix turtle scule unit repair
- force migration of sweeping edge
- remove legacy useInFuture usage as per the two previous points was blocking. not anymore
- Made unit repair work better with custom items
- Fix durability not repairing based on max damage
- Make update checker use current minecraft version for update check

name: v1.17.0 lot of fixes and features
changelog:
Hi ! Been some time since last update
There are a lot of new things and fixes here !
Also, a lot of internal changes so if there is any issue please report them <3
As always, all new features are opt in so check [latest config file](https://github.com/alexcrea/CustomAnvil/blob/v1.x.x/src/main/resources/config.yml) if you wish to use one of these and already has a modified config 

### Features:
- Per color code permission #114
- Rename dialog (allow longer rename) #113
- Monetary cost (via vault) #116 
- Trying to add compatibility with EcoItem #106 
- Trying to add compatibility with ItemAdder #112
- Added Compatibility with SuperEnchant #111

note:
for monetary cost you need rename dialog enabled

#### Breaking change:
- `CATreatAnvilResultEvent` is marked for removal and not called anymore. Use `CATreatAnvilResult2Event`

If any issue for the above please report them !

### Fixes & other:
- Fix some "validate" issue (right item is null somehow)
- Switch most usage of material to namespaced key
- Do not crash out if a yml material group or conflict is not a valid yml section
- Add more spigot deprecation warning as replace too expensive will require protocolib for 26.1+ for spigot (no native nms)
- Fix not checking if max damage when setting damage

Also last big version that support versions under 1.21, a lot of legacy code will be deleted in v1.18 !

## New Contributors
* @trashypixl made their first contribution in https://github.com/alexcrea/CustomAnvil/pull/110

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alexcrea/CustomAnvil/compare/v1.16.2...v1.17.0

name: CustomAnvil 1.11.0
changelog:
## Features:
- Allow add and remove of item lore via writable books and paper (Merge from beta)
note: there is no config gui currently for this feature. all relevant configurations should get added to the config.yml automatically so check it out after update !

example of the configuration to add to config.yml for an enchantment with the namespaced key minecraft:immutability_curse

```yml
immutable_enchantments:

```

- Fix issue on multi line paper remove (issue from lore edit beta)

- somehow a weird incompatibility with vane-portals
